A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''crime lord''' was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raisa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. When the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] began stirring up anti-Republic sentiment on Raisa, an Imperial-allied individual ran the Republic [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] around Raisa to deliver a black market shipment of Imperial weapons to help her cause, prompting the crime lord to offer the individual a substantial bonus.<ref name="Fueling Dissent" />
